primaryMetric: case-sensitive exact-line rate; NFC and collapsed whitespace; punctuation preserved
testPolicy: No test decoding until validation-selected checkpoint is frozen
foundationCaveat: TrOCR handwritten foundations already used IAM; this is adaptation, not an unseen-corpus claim
readiness: Passing line gates is insufficient for full-page or Android release
checkpointSelection: highest validation exact-line rate; tie-break lower validation CER; never select by final test
evaluationBoundary: The v1 final IAM test has been evaluated. Further choices use validation only; new final evidence needs a separate locked holdout or explicitly disclosed reused benchmark.
publicationGate: Do not publish weights as accepted until this policy and source/model redistribution requirements are verified
